title: Cover terminal retention registration map keys differing from stored run ids
outcome: Cover terminal retention registration map keys differing from stored run ids
acceptance: A deterministic behavioral regression covers a registration whose map key differs from its stored run id and confirms terminal candidate selection agrees with the original exact matching predicates and entry ordering.
The registration candidate accessor contract documents any required summary.run_id equals disk.run_id invariant, without source-text or Markdown phrase tests.
